evidence.statement: The native editor copies group and name from the stored jobKeyDTO. JobService updates the same group/name URL. The response key must be bound to the consumer resource path; it is not part of ScheduledJobInputDTO.

The native editor loads class, description, durable, requestsRecovery and jobDataMap from the stored job; submission sends a complete command. The consumer changes description while preserving the accepted producer class and other fields.

reference_expectation.statement: The fixed complete command uses the native SampleJob subclass, a nonblank class name, durable=true, requestsRecovery=false and an empty data map. Create stores the job and update replaces that same stored key with the changed description. This is the original ordinary positive-control workload; UI/UI is the generation reference, not a normative source of validation rules.

cost_estimate.source: UNMEASURED PLACEHOLDER: positive scalar required by the existing selector schema. No Quartz candidate durations have been calibrated; the prior valid-control elapsed time is not used as a mutation-cost estimate.

registration.positive_control_scope: One fixed workload on four routes; not generated-pool execution. Earlier startup/authentication/automation diagnostics are documented there.
registration.mutation_selection_basis: Five conventional single-field required-value and eligible-value probes chosen from pinned source constraints; no Quartz mutated job inputs or known-issue searches were executed.

corrections.reason: Review found that the prior normalization sentence claimed comparison of all scheduler fields while the environment list named only a subset. The sentence is narrowed to the listed comparison scope, with omitted scheduler fields enumerated. v1 is also explicitly labeled a rejection/control stratum requiring an accepted-value v2 before freeze.

pinned_sources.equivalence: GitHub comparison between release and checkout modifies only README.md.

native_ui_actions: populate fixed job group/name and command fields

oracle.input_semantics: Operation inputs are templates for JSON request bodies. Group/name are separate resource-path bindings. A future adapter must resolve accepted output bindings before editing and must never replace an accepted producer-mutated field with the baseline template.
execution_conditions: No boundary candidate has been run. Do not pass this pool to the positive-control script: that script accepts only fixed valid commands and does not consume registries.
Any future executor must use the documented matching official 5.0.1 UI/backend artifacts, complete dependency classpath and Europe/Rome JVM timezone without application source changes.
Restart the native process independently for every complete case; verify the empty RAM store, same admin/ROLE_ADMIN principal, scheduler STOPPED, zero triggers and zero executions.
Send exactly the declared one-property API mutation, leaving the other producer fields fixed. Do not start/resume the scheduler, create a trigger, or invoke job execution.
Record producer status and body, then read stored jobs regardless of success or rejection. A rejected creation must leave the reset state unchanged; rejection alone does not prove rollback.
If creation rejects, stop the continuation. Do not fabricate a resource key, mark dependency coverage, count an unattempted consumer as passed, or treat declared target edges as observed.

If creation unexpectedly accepts, retain and read the actual stored job before continuing. Verify returned group/name against the intended fixed identity; bind jobClassName to consumer jobClass and preserve durable, requestsRecovery and jobDataMap. Do not silently repair an unexpected class by choosing the valid baseline.

For a UI consumer, use a fresh native session, open the returned job, verify loaded field values against the accepted state and change only description. If the returned class has no native select option, retain that representation failure instead of replacing it.

For an API consumer, GET the same bound resource and PUT the bound complete command with only description changed. Record actual status and state rather than requiring all rejection probes to reach this step.

For an accepted continuation, perform fresh API and native UI reads, compare returned identity and preserved fields, require the requested new description, and verify zero triggers/executions and no unexpected stored jobs.

Source expectations are hypotheses for conformance checking. Record actual rejection status separately, including 4xx versus 5xx; this registration does not prescribe status codes, label defects or credit selector coverage.
The generic generator does not validate or resolve opaque oracle bindings. A future adapter must implement and validate the declared resource and state bindings before any candidate execution.

business_state_comparison.description: Requested meaningful edit after accepted continuation; original producer description before it.
business_state_comparison.normalization: Compare only the listed business fields and environment checks, normalizing JSON object-key order only. This declarative candidate scope does not compare every scheduler response field.

scope_limits.enum_kind: enum denotes explicitly enumerated finite literals (three spaces and java.lang.String). It does not declare a static API enum containing those values.
scope_limits.native_ui_exclusions: All ten UI-producer mutation combinations are excluded. Exact omission/null and non-option values have no native class-select mapping; the unchanged v1 generator also permits API payload mutations only.
scope_limits.path_constraints: Group/name URL syntax, defaults, trimming and collisions are outside the object-property mutation schema. They are fixed here and require a separately specified path/state adapter before probing.
scope_limits.dynamic_allowed_values: Eligible job classes depend on the pinned classpath and configured packages. The generator neither discovers nor enforces that list. The fixed SampleJob control and java.lang.String exclusion are justified by pinned source.
scope_limits.fields_held_fixed: description, durable, requestsRecovery and jobDataMap remain fixed except the requested description edit. Their omission, null, coercion, nested-map and storage-semantic variants are not registered in this required-class slice; this is a scope choice, not a claim of generator or UI impossibility.
scope_limits.unmodeled_variants: No simultaneous mutations, path fuzzing, duplicate fixture creation, scheduler lifecycle, triggers, job execution, timing, recovery behavior or persistence mode changes.
scope_limits.interpretation: Prospective preparation only. Four prior controls do not validate this generated pool; generated cases do not establish coverage, defect prevalence, fault yield, selector effectiveness or held-out generalization.
scope_limits.evaluation_stratum: v1 is a rejection/control stratum: four valid route controls and ten mutants all expected to reject at the producer. It is unsuitable as the primary evaluation of an oracle for accepted states. A separately source-registered accepted-value v2 stratum is still required before study freeze; no v2 is built or executed by this correction.
